    """Fill the interiors of square 2-frames, preserving their marked cell.

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = []

        for r2 in range(r1 + 2, h):
            for c1 in range(w):
                c2 = c1 + (r2 - r1)
                if c2 >= w:
                    continue
                if (all(grid[r1][c] == 2 for c in range(c1, c2 + 1)) and
                    all(grid[r2][c] == 2 for c in range(c1, c2 + 1)) and
                    all(grid[r][c1] == 2 for r in range(r1, r2 + 1)) and
                    all(grid[r][c2] == 2 for r in range(r1, r2 + 1))):
                    candidates.append((r1, r2, c1, c2))

    maximal = []
    for rect in candidates:
        r1, r2, c1, c2 = rect
        if not any(a <= r1 and b >= r2 and c <= c1 and d >= c2 and other != rect
                   for other in candidates
